reviews.review_description:
Playing Crescendo again has brought me joy after not running through it since the Closure.
I also appreciate the fact that Eduard has set Developer for everyone since I now can experiment with URL Video Players.
There's not much Good cosmetics which is fine, I already like my current Full Body Avatar.
I do, very much Agree with the Creator not wanting Children in the Archive for it can get irritating fast having to be around them.
Definitely hope this lasts for Quite a while, also intrigued with what will be brought, further in the future.
